notes: Paper Prop 3.2 (i) and (ii) plus the two residual identities displayed after its proof. Carrier: arbitrary unital ring (A : Type* [Ring A]), D : A ->+ A additive, alpha : A ->+ A additive with alpha(x*y)=alpha x*alpha y (case i) or alpha(x*y)=alpha y*alpha x (case ii); case (i)/(ii) assume hDalpha : forall x, D (alpha x) = alpha (D x), as the paper does. The residual identities assume no relation between D and alpha, which is what the paper says of them. Stronger than the paper: additive maps rather than K-linear, and no involution and no bijectivity of alpha is assumed (unused). The same two iff statements for alpha : R =~+* R are prop_defect_aut and prop_defect_anti in TwistedCommutative.lean. label: cor:twisted-semiprime
notes: Paper Cor 3.5, both halves. Statement: (BSD.TwistedAlpha alpha D and BSD.JDer D) iff BSD.Der D, under hDalpha : BSD.Comm D alpha, h2 : Background.JordanHerstein.TwoTorsionFree A and hs : Background.JordanHerstein.SemiprimeRing A -- the paper's 2-torsion-free and semiprime hypotheses. hDalpha is a standing hypothesis, so the statement is the paper's set equality BSDer_{sigma_alpha}(A)^alpha cap JDer(A) = Der(A)^alpha read inside the alpha-commuting class. Stronger than the paper: additive maps; the anti-automorphism half (alpha : R =~+ R, hmul, h1 : alpha 1 = 1) assumes no involution at all, while the paper's sentence assumes alpha involutive. The paper's cited Bresar 1988 Theorem 1 is proved in-tree (Bresar1988.bresar1988Theorem1_holds), so no hBresar hypothesis remains; the conditional forms BSD.corollary_3_5 and AntiAutomorphism.corollary_3_5_anti are kept for reference and are not what this row binds. Axiom footprint propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound for both (repository audit, lean/check_axioms.lean).

label: thm:twisted-commutative
notes: Paper Thm 4.1 as an iff: BSD.TwistedAlpha alpha D iff BSD.Der D for [CommRing A] [IsReduced A], alpha : A =~+* A with halphaalpha : forall x, alpha (alpha x) = x, D : A ->+ A, h2 : IsUnit (2 : A), hDalpha : BSD.Comm D alpha. Hypotheses match the paper's sentence (commutative, reduced, 2 invertible, alpha an involutive automorphism); two differences of rendering, neither a weakening: D is additive A ->+ A rather than K-linear A -> A (a strengthening), and 2-invertibility is stated in A as IsUnit (2 : A) rather than in K -- implied by '2 invertible in K' for a K-algebra and the form the proof uses. Relative to the SHARPENED statement inside the paper's proof (lines 491-494, arbitrary ring, symmetric defect, no nonzero square-zero z in A_-) the Lean hypothesis [IsReduced A] is stronger; that sharpened form is the proved BSDGeneral.thm41_core and lean/RESULTS.md records the difference against that statement, not against the theorem's sentence, so the status is not lowered. twisted_commutative is the one-way kernel proof theorem_4_1 uses. Axiom footprint propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound for all three (BSD.theorem_4_1 and twisted_commutative in the repository audit, BSDGeneral.thm41_core in my own run).

label: prop:twisted
lean_decl: TW.D1_alphader; TW.D1_not_twisted; TW.dd_der; TW.dd_not_alphader; TW.D1_comm_alpha; TW.dd_comm_alpha; Closures.TW_D1_alphader_all; Closures.TW_dd_der_all; Closures.TW_D1_comm_alpha_all; Closures.TW_dd_comm_alpha_all
notes: Paper Prop 4.4 on A = F_3[eps]/(eps^3) with alpha(eps) = -eps, modelled as TW.V = Fin 3 -> ZMod 3 with TW.mul the convolution truncated at degree 2 (eps^3 = 0) and TW.alpha negating the eps coordinate. First non-inclusion, ADer not subset BSDer^alpha: D1 (kills 1, fixes eps and eps^2) satisfies the alpha-derivation rule on all 81 pairs (Closures.TW_D1_alphader_all, superseding the basis-pair TW.D1_alphader) and commutes with alpha, but fails the twisted rule at (eps,eps) (TW.D1_not_twisted). Second non-inclusion, BSDer^alpha not subset ADer: dd(eps^i) = i eps^i is a derivation on all 81 pairs (Closures.TW_dd_der_all) and commutes with alpha, hence lies in the twisted class by the proved Prop 3.2 (der_twisted_iff_comm) -- that last step is a one-line deduction, not a separate declaration -- and dd fails the alpha-derivation rule at (eps,eps) (TW.dd_not_alphader). The Lean states the two witnesses, not a set-theoretic non-inclusion sentence; both non-inclusions follow from these facts with no gap. Axiom footprint propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound for all ten (TW and Closures are NOT in lean/check_axioms.lean; footprints from my own run).
